title: General Manager
description:
Executive impact: Lead P&C strategy and report directly to the CEO
Strategic leadership: Drive organisational goals and cultural change
Financial sector growth: Build capacity in a leading financial services firm.
A Leadership Opportunity in Papua New Guinea’s Financial Services
An established and leading financial services institution, committed to its customer-centric vision and dedicated to building the capacity of its workforce, is seeking a high-calibre executive to join its leadership team.
We are looking for an experienced and strategic Human Resources professional to step into the role of
General Manager - People & Culture (P&C)
, reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer (CEO). This is a functional leader position that actively contributes to achieving organisational goals by ensuring the HR environment is effectively managed and the organization possesses the talent required for success.
Key Responsibilities
The General Manager - People & Culture will work as part of the executive team to provide strategic direction and oversight across all human resource disciplines.
Strategic Leadership & Planning:
Develop and implement an
overarching People Strategy
that aligns with the customer-centric focus, with an emphasis on
building capacity and workforce planning
.
Provide vision, policy, strategy, and direction setting for both the organisation and the P&C Department.
Maintain current knowledge of the workforce environment, best practice HR strategies, and legislative changes.
Talent Management & Development:
Develop and implement
best practice attraction and retention strategies
to ensure the organization has the necessary talent.
Ensure the correct business model, structure, design, and salary administration policies are in place to
attract and retain talent
.
Develop and implement strategies to promote the company as an
employer of choice
, increasing employee engagement and participation.
Compliance, Management & Advice:
Ensure compliance with
BPNG Prudential Standards
and
PNG employment laws
.
Develop and implement
fit-for-purpose policies
to effectively manage HR functions, ensuring compliance and optimizing team performance.
Key Requirements
Qualifications:
A relevant qualification in
HR, Industrial Psychology, or equivalent demonstrated experience
.
Experience:
A minimum of
5 years with extensive experience
working in similar roles that manage a
multi-disciplinary HR function
, preferably in the
Financial Services industry
.
Technical Knowledge:
Technical knowledge in
Superannuation, HRM & HRD practises, and advanced practical understanding of PNG labour laws
.
Leadership & Communication:
Must possess
exceptional skills in Leading a team, management, planning, and budgeting
. This includes
superior relationship building, negotiation, and influencing skills
, as well as extensive skill in written and verbal communication.
Advanced Competencies:
Advanced proficiency in
Planning & Organising, Delegation, Problem Solving, Decision Making, and Coaching and People Development
.
This is a dynamic opportunity for a proven leader to join an Executive Management team and directly influence the future success and culture of a key player in the PNG financial sector.
If you possess the strategic vision, executive experience, and technical expertise in HR to drive organisational goals and build a talented, compliant workforce, we encourage your application.
Submit your application, by clicking on the 'APPLY NOW' button and uploading your CV and covering letter in MS Word Format
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
